exposure: early probiotic supplementation (at the age of 0-27 days)
Probiotic supplementation at the age of 0-27 days
Probiotic supplementation during the first year of life
outcome: Islet autoimmunity revealed by specific islet autoantibodies
cohort: 7473 children at increased genetic risk of type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM)
finding: Early probiotic supplementation (at the age of 0-27 days) was associated with a decreased risk of islet autoimmunity in children at the highest genetic risk of T1DM, particularly those with the DR3/4 genotype.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was a factor adjusted for in the analysis.
country: United States (Colorado, Georgia/Florida, and Washington) and Europe (Finland, Germany, and Sweden)
